summary: Tested Admin Leads (/admin/leads) advanced filters, server-side pagination, URL persistence and filtered export, plus Meta Files (/meta/files) filters, pagination, URL persistence and role visibility, via both API (pytest, 18 tests) and Playwright UI. Admin Leads works end to end. The salary buckets add up exactly (15+124+152+89+139=519). The employment buckets add up too. AND logic is checked row by row. City search narrows 403 options to 39 for 'hyder'. Page sizes are 25/50/100/200 and Prev/Next/Go-to work. Changing a filter resets to page 1. Loading ?salary=100000-&emp=salaried&page=3 restores Employment (1), Salary Range (1) and Page 3 of 4, and the state survives detail→Back and a refresh. Clear Filters returns all 519 rows. The UI export downloaded 124 rows, which equals the filtered total, with Employment and Net Salary columns. On Meta Files, docs received + pending = 19+3=22 and assigned + unassigned = 21+1=22. Bank filter works. ?docs=received&page=2&size=10 restores the filter and page, and detail→Back keeps it. ROLE VISIBILITY passes: the GP (Anusha) sees only her own 6 files and 27 leads. The Processor/Growth Partner/Assignment filters are hidden for her, and staff-only URL params (proc/gp/asg/partner) are ignored by the backend. Her filter-options return only her own values (HL; ICICI, PIRAMAL). The processor (teja) sees only his 1 assigned file, and processor=ALL does not widen that scope. Bugs found: (1) the Requested Loan Type option 'Personal loan' returns 0 files because of whitespace and case mismatch; (2) the bank filter crashes with a 500 when the input contains regex special characters; (3) HR can call /api/leads/filter-options and /api/leads/export even though /api/leads gives them a 403; (4) a few minor UI state issues. NOTE: the documented GP password (MetaGP123! and the old 9063023292) both return 401, so GP tests used a JWT minted directly from the backend JWT secret for the real GP account (tests/mint_token.py). Nothing in the DB was changed.

critical.issue: SECURITY: both endpoints use Depends(get_current_user) instead of require_not_hr. HR (hr@neosales.in) gets 403 on GET /api/leads but 200 on filter-options, which leaks every distinct city/address. HR also gets 200 on POST /api/leads/export with {}, which downloads the FULL lead dataset. build_leads_query only scopes GP roles, so any non-GP, non-management role sees everything. filter-options is new in this change. The export gap may already have existed, but it breaks the 'never expose unauthorized data' requirement. Fix: use require_not_hr (or the same dependency as list_leads) on both endpoints, and on stats/select-all-ids too if they share this.

The Requested Loan Type filter matches exactly, but /meta/files/filter-options strips the values. The DB has file.loan_type='Personal loan ' (trailing space), so selecting 'Personal loan' returns 0 files (confirmed in the UI: 'No files match your filters'). The options also contain case-variant duplicates: 'Personal Loan' and 'Personal loan', and banks 'PIRAMAL' and 'piramal'. Fix: match loan_type case-insensitively with optional surrounding whitespace, e.g. {'$regex': f'^\s*{re.escape(v)}\s*$', '$options': 'i'}, and dedupe options case-insensitively.

minor.issue: The bank value goes into $regex without re.escape. bank='ICICI (test' returns 500. Use re.escape(bank). Since it is a substring regex, 'HDFC' would also match e.g. 'HDFC Credila'. Consider an anchored, escaped match.
The frontend sends sort_by=file_created_at, which is not in SORT_FIELDS, so the backend silently falls back to created_time. Files are therefore not sorted by file-conversion date.

Data quality: the 'city' field has many street addresses (e.g. '1-1-191/1', 'Q.no 164 / 1 RE colony vizianagaram'), so the 403 City options are noisy. Not a code bug, but the searchable City dropdown is hard to use.

ui_bugs.issue: When the URL has size=10 (as in the review's sample URL), the list really uses 10 per page ('Showing 11–19 of 19'), but the select shows '25 / page' because PAGE_SIZES=[25,50,100] has no 10. Either clamp/normalize the URL size to an allowed value or add the option.

For a GP, loading /meta/files?asg=unassigned&proc=UNASSIGNED&gp=ALL shows '3 filters applied' even though those filters are hidden and ignored. activeCount counts processor, growthPartner and assignment regardless of isStaff. Only count staff-only params when isStaff, or drop them from state for non-staff.

ui_bugs.component: Meta Files 'My Files' toggle for processor
ui_bugs.issue: The toggle appears for processors but does nothing, because myOnly is only sent when isStaff (backend already scopes processors). Toggling only changes the URL.

integration_issues.issue: Selecting 'Personal loan' returns no results (see the backend loan_type whitespace issue).

issues: The Bank/Lender column shows '—' for files that the Bank filter matches through file.banks[].bank_name, because FileRow only reads disbursed_bank/approved_bank/login_bank/bank/lender. Users filter by HDFC and see rows with no bank shown.
The Docs column shows '—' when docs_received is missing, but the Docs=Pending filter counts those files as pending. Show 'Pending' for consistency.

action_items: HIGH: Restrict /api/leads/filter-options and /api/leads/export to the same roles as GET /api/leads (require_not_hr). HR can currently export all leads.
HIGH: Make the Meta loan_type filter case- and whitespace-tolerant, and dedupe loan_type/bank options case-insensitively ('Personal loan ' currently returns 0).
Escape the bank regex in /api/meta/leads (re.escape). Special characters currently cause a 500.
Meta Files: normalize the URL 'size' to an allowed page size, or add 10 to the select.
Meta Files: don't count hidden staff-only params in 'X filters applied' for non-staff. Hide or wire up 'My Files' for processors.
Meta Files: add 'file_created_at' to SORT_FIELDS or send a supported sort field.
Meta Files row: show the bank from file.banks[].bank_name as a fallback.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: the GP yarragondaanusha@gmail.com password MetaGP123! (and 9063023292) no longer works (401).
critical_code_review_comments: leads.py get_leads_filter_options uses get_current_user, while list_leads uses require_not_hr. This is an inconsistent auth dependency and lets HR enumerate lead data.
meta.py meta_leads: bank and q values go into $regex unescaped (ReDoS risk and 500s).

Salary 'none' bucket only matches null/missing/''. Non-numeric strings like 'N/A' or '30k' would fall into no bucket, and counts would stop adding up. They add up today (519) but the filter is fragile. Consider also catching values where $convert gives null.
Admin Leads.js is about 1250 lines. It should be split (filters panel, pagination bar, list).
Meta Files search has no debounce, so every keystroke fires a request and resets the page.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core flows pass; loan-type filter and page-size display issues)

rca of the issue: Loan type: meta_files_filter_options does str(x).strip() on the distinct values, but meta_leads filters with exact equality query['file.loan_type']=loan_type. DB value 'Personal loan ' != 'Personal loan', so the result is 0. Repro: GET /api/meta/leads?status=FILE&loan_type=Personal%20loan returns total 0. HR leak: GET /api/leads/filter-options and POST /api/leads/export with an HR token return 200, while GET /api/leads returns 403.
